purpose: Read-only integration qualification for task assignment changes that arrived during the final publishing race. Counts are separate from company-document and earlier concurrent AnA qualification.

whatAlreadyExists.responsibility: Existing task board/detail and automatic saved-task assignment; named handoff now reaches the same detail and existing write endpoints.
Shared handoff form reads eligible candidates and current assignment before a reasoned compare-and-set write; terminal/read-only/invalidactor states do not offer assignment.
Canonical authenticated request/error readers plus capturedactorheaders are reused for roster/manual/automatic paths, with current actor/task/workspace ownership and receipt guards.
Shared roster/receipt contract validates exact org/actor/task/project, recorded workspace, expectedassignee/version, servercanAssign and bounded distinct candidate identities.

verification.command: vitest run [four exact test paths below] --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=verbose --reporter=json

review: Task/account/organization handlers and late receipts are retired when captured ownership changes; selectedworkspace is carried in the existing x-client-id header and serverrecorded scope is retained for writes.
Manual handoff requires eligiblecandidate, boundedhumanreason, expectedassignee and assignmentversion. Automatic handoff sends fresh expectedassignment to the existing endpoint.

Unconfirmed network/5xx/malformedwrite results do not become success; writes require a fresh rosterread before retry. TaskDetail advancement/archive controls are blocked while the assignment flow is open.
Assignment declares no new projectaccess, reviewassignment or electronicsigning authority; servercanAssign and scopednativeauthorization remain authoritative.
Global stylesheet changes are six .c2c-v2 .tb-assignment-prefixed rules. They do not target CompanyDocumentSettings or change shared .c2c-input, button or form base rules.

qualificationLimits: These four suites exercise the existing component/request harnesses, including mocked HTTP results; they do not establish live backend commit, audit durability or production deployment.
Backend assignment/authorization qualification, final fullbuild/typecheck, companysourcepin refresh and normalpushhooks are owned by the controller and the backend agent.
No production files, tests, dependencies or companysourcepins were edited by this read-onlyreview.
